Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026 OUT: Your Gateway to the Common Entrance Exam!

The Indian Army has officially released the much-awaited Agniveer Admit Card 2026, marking a critical step for thousands of aspiring candidates ready to embark on their journey to serve the nation. If you’ve applied for the Agniveer Recruitment 2026 under the transformative Agnipath Scheme, your hall ticket is now available for download on the official website. This article provides you with all the essential details, direct links, and crucial instructions to ensure a smooth examination experience.

The Indian Army Agniveer Common Entrance Examination (CEE) 2026 is scheduled to be conducted from **June 1 to June 15, 2026,** across various centers nationwide. Ensure you download your admit card well in advance!

Key Dates for Indian Army Agniveer CEE 2026

Staying informed about important dates is paramount for all candidates. Here’s a quick overview of the crucial timelines for the Agniveer 2026 recruitment cycle:

Event Date
Agniveer Registration Period February 13 to April 10, 2026
Agniveer Admit Card Release Date May 15, 2026 (Phase-wise release from May 15 - May 21, 2026)
Agniveer CEE 2026 Exam Dates June 1 to June 15, 2026

How to Download Your Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026

The process to download your admit card is straightforward. Follow these detailed steps to access your hall ticket from the official Indian Army website:

1. Visit the Official Website
Open your web browser and navigate to the official Indian Army recruitment portal: joinindianarmy.nic.in.
2. Enter Website / Captcha
If prompted, enter the security Captcha code and click on "Enter Website" to proceed.
3. Locate Admit Card Link
On the homepage, look for the "Agnipath" section and then click on "Login / Apply Online". Alternatively, you might find a direct link under the "Admit Card" or "Important Links" section specifically for "Admit Card for Common Entrance Exam for Agniveer, JCOs/OR 2026-27."
4. Log In with Credentials
You will be redirected to the login page. Enter your Registration Number (or Email ID) and Password, which you received during your application process.
5. Access Candidate Dashboard
After successful login, you will land on your candidate dashboard. Navigate to the "Admit Card" tab.
6. Download Your Admit Card
Click on the link for "Agniveer Common Entrance Exam (CEE) Admit Card 2026". Your admit card will appear on the screen in PDF format.
7. Print Multiple Copies
Download the PDF and take at least 2-3 color printouts of your admit card. This is a mandatory document to carry to the examination center.

Crucial Details to Verify on Your Admit Card

Once you've downloaded your Agniveer Admit Card 2026, it is imperative to meticulously check all the information printed on it. Any discrepancy should be reported to the concerned authorities immediately. Here’s what you need to verify:

✅ Candidate’s Name and Roll Number

✅ Father’s Name

✅ Date of Birth

✅ Examination Date and Day

✅ Reporting Time and Shift Schedule

✅ Exam City and Full Examination Centre Address

✅ Post Applied For (e.g., Agniveer GD, Technical, Clerk, Tradesman, Women Military Police)

✅ Important Exam Day Instructions

✅ Your Photograph and Signature

Essential Documents & Instructions for Exam Day

To ensure a hassle-free entry and smooth examination process, candidates must adhere to specific guidelines and carry certain documents on the day of the CEE:

1. Printed Admit Card
A clear, colored printout of your Agniveer Admit Card 2026 is mandatory. Black and white copies might not be accepted.
2. Valid Photo Identity Proof
Carry an original, valid photo ID proof such as your Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License. The name on your ID must match the name on your admit card.
3. Recent Passport-sized Photographs
It is advisable to carry a few recent passport-sized color photographs, similar to the one uploaded during your application.
4. Reporting Time
Candidates are advised to reach the examination center at least 1 to 1.5 hours before the scheduled exam time. The entry gates will close 30 minutes prior to the commencement of the exam, and no candidate will be allowed entry thereafter.
5. QR Code Feature
The Indian Army has introduced a new QR code feature on the admit card, which can be used to check exam center details, location access, and specific instructions.
6. Prohibited Items
Do not carry any electronic gadgets, mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, or study material into the examination hall. Follow all instructions provided by the invigilators.

Facing Issues? Troubleshooting Your Admit Card Download

If you encounter any problems while downloading your admit card, consider these common solutions:

✅ Double-check your login credentials (registration number/email ID and password).

✅ Clear your browser's cache and cookies, or try using a different web browser.

✅ Ensure your internet connection is stable.

✅ If you've forgotten your password, use the "Forgot Password" option on the login page.

✅ If issues persist, contact the Indian Army's helpline number (e.g., 9513252885) or email ID (e.g., Indianarmycee2026@gmail.com) provided in the official notifications.

The release of the Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026 marks the final stretch before the Common Entrance Exam. Stay focused on your preparation, adhere to all guidelines, and approach the examination with confidence. We wish all the aspiring Agniveers the very best!
